svg.title: THS v2 HAL wiring with a 200-contact breadboard
svg.desc: Firmware-assigned electrical wiring. Module connectors are logical power, signal, miscellaneous order, not physical pin order. Straight wire vectors have no splices; named bus terminals connect through the breadboard. Two isolated I2C controllers avoid the TCS and ToF reset address conflict.
svg.text: STM32F411CE Black Pill • 2 isolated I²C buses • DRV8833 • ESP32-C6 / LuatOS CORE ESP32-C3
Logical connector order: POWER → SIGNALS → MISC. The symbols do not specify physical module pin positions.
Every wire is one straight vector. Crossings are unconnected. Named open-circle bus terminals are connected by the breadboard rows below.
GPIO1: NC • XSHUT: local logic pull-up
GPIO1: NC • XSHUT: local logic pull-up
GPIO1: NC • XSHUT: local logic pull-up
7-bit: fixed 0x29 • separate from ToF boot bus
C6 or LuatOS CORE C3 • SPI slave
Do not power the radio from Black Pill 3V3.
A → left motor • B → right motor
3V3 = regulated logic bus; all GNDs common.
Use an adequately rated external 3V3 regulator.
Black Pill 3V3 pin is supply input in this sketch.
Motor VM stays off the breadboard logic buses.
USB: data + GND; avoid feeding a second power source.
XSHUT: open-drain; pull up to module-permitted rail.
Select sensor breakouts accepting 3V3 supply / I²C.
Optional on-board SPI flash must be absent/isolated.
PB3 = I²C2; SWO unavailable. SWD RTT is retained.
SOURCE-CONFIGURED DESIGN • not a physical qualification • USB upload/serial and SWD use existing board connectors • no encoder wiring
